purpose: Evidence-backed Clockify service-routing matrix (ROUTE-001). H02-ROUTING-approved 2026-07-27; ROUTE-002 shipped runtime routing in SDK 0.13.0. No runtime code imports this file -- wrapper/internal/routing.ts keeps an equality-pinned hand-written copy of the approved rows, guarded by wrapper/tests/routing-matrix-equality.test.ts. Every non-null row carries a sourcePointer and proofKind; every unsupported combination is explicit (url: null + unsupportedReason).
nonGoals: Live-confirming regional/US/UK/AU/developer profile routing against a real regional or subdomain-configured workspace is explicitly deferred: no such sacrificial workspace is currently available (confirmed 2026-07-27). These rows remain liveConfirmationRequired:true, shipped as opt-in if/when ROUTE-002 implements them -- never as globally-trusted defaults -- until a regional/subdomain sandbox becomes available.

Removing pto.api.clockify.me / auditing developer.clockify.me in wrapper/internal/authenticated-boundary-fetch.ts and scripts/sdk-codegen/emitter.mjs's allowlists is runtime code (ROUTE-002), out of scope for this evidence-only matrix. This approval only records that pto.api.clockify.me routes no operation (see conflicts[0]).

sources.official: spec/official/clockify.official.openapi.yaml#/info/description ("## API URLs" and "## Regional Server Prefixes" sections)

operationServiceDerivation.method: Every corrected-spec operation resolved by its effective server (operation-level `servers` override, else the first root `servers` entry), classified by hostname. Computed live by scripts/service-routing-matrix.mjs against spec/corrected/clockify.corrected.openapi.yaml; the checker compares these stored counts to the current derivation and fails closed on drift.
operationServiceDerivation.note: No operation resolves to a fourth host. "pto" (time-off) operations resolve to the regular api host -- there is no per-operation servers override routing them elsewhere. This is empirical fact, not evidence that time-off has no distinct service; see conflicts[0].

reports.sourcePointer: spec/corrected/clockify.corrected.openapi.yaml#/servers/1 and 10 per-operation overrides; spec/official#/info/description "API URLs > Global > Reports"

audit.note: Not documented in spec/official's prose (no audit host example there); proven directly by the corrected spec's own operation override instead.

pto.unsupportedReason: Confirmed by H02-ROUTING (apet97, 2026-07-27): pto.api.clockify.me is unrouted allowlist code, not a service this SDK targets -- see conflicts[0]. No corrected-spec operation resolves to a distinct pto host; time-off operations resolve to the regular api host (see operationServiceDerivation). This row intentionally does NOT default to the api host: that would assert pto has no distinct service by inference rather than by confirmed decision.

subdomainReportsTemplate.sourcePointer: spec/official#/info/description "API URLs > Regional > Subdomain > Reports" (literal placeholder "yoursubdomainname.clockify.me")
subdomainReportsTemplate.subdomainValidation: See scripts/service-routing-matrix.mjs#validateSubdomainLabel: lowercase, 1-63 chars, alphanumeric/hyphen only, no leading/trailing hyphen, no dots, no punycode/xn-- prefix.
subdomainReportsTemplate.note: Confirmed by H02-ROUTING (apet97, 2026-07-27): a workspace subdomain changes only Reports routing. Regular/API stays on the region-prefix host (profiles.*.regular) regardless of subdomain configuration -- the official doc's "Subdomain" section shows Regular as the identical literal euc1.clockify.me/api/v1 example already captured under profiles.eu.regular, and Reports alone uses the subdomain host.

conflicts.description: wrapper/internal/authenticated-boundary-fetch.ts (CLOCKIFY_PROD_HOSTS) and scripts/sdk-codegen/emitter.mjs (CLOCKIFY_API_HOSTS) both allowlist pto.api.clockify.me. It has zero backing operations in spec/corrected and zero mentions in spec/official's prose. (developer.clockify.me is also allowlisted there; that one is NOT a conflict -- it matches spec/official's Developer profile prose at the same official-doc-only evidence tier as the regional templates, see profiles.developer.)
conflicts.resolution: Confirmed by H02-ROUTING (apet97, 2026-07-27): pto.api.clockify.me routes no operation, so profiles.*.pto stays null + unsupportedReason. The decision stands, but the earlier 'dead host' justification does not: on 2026-08-07 the host answered 200 to GET /user with the same credentials as the regular host. It is reachable and un-targeted, not absent. Removing the host from the runtime allowlist is ROUTE-002 work, out of scope for this evidence-only matrix (see nonGoals).

conflicts.description: Regional and subdomain reports routing (path-discriminated <prefix-or-subdomain>.clockify.me/report/v1) is documented only in spec/official's prose examples, with no corresponding spec/corrected per-operation servers override for any region and no live-evidence-manifest row proving it against a real regional/subdomain workspace. Global reports routing (host-discriminated reports.api.clockify.me) is fully proven by spec/corrected.
evidence: spec/official#/info/description "API URLs > Regional" and "> Developer" sections
conflicts.resolution: Resolved by H02-ROUTING (apet97, 2026-07-27): a live probe was the preferred resolution, but no regional or subdomain-configured sacrificial workspace is currently available to probe against. Regional/developer/subdomain rows ship as opt-in with liveConfirmationRequired:true (see nonGoals), not as globally-trusted defaults, until such a workspace exists.
resolutionOptions: Authorize a read-only live probe against an authorized regional/subdomain sacrificial workspace to confirm the templated regional/developer/subdomain rows before ROUTE-002 treats them as fully supported (preferred once such a workspace exists).
Ship ROUTE-002 with these profiles marked liveConfirmationRequired (opt-in, documented as unconfirmed) rather than fully supported -- SELECTED, see resolution above.
Defer regional/developer/subdomain profile support entirely until live-confirmed.
